content: Windows CRLF breaks Linux container entrypoints: git core.autocrlf=true converts LF->CRLF on checkout; shebang becomes #!/bin/sh\r and kernel looks for interpreter /bin/sh\r -> misleading 'exec user process caused no such file or directory' / standard_init_linux.go error though file exists. Defense in depth: commit .gitattributes (*.sh text eol=lf, plus mvnw/Dockerfile), Dockerfile safety net sed -i s/\r$// after COPY, dos2unix. Maven wrapper ./mvnw is itself a shell script - same hazard inside maven build stage. Also .env files with CRLF can poison values with trailing \r (JWT secrets!) causing intermittent auth mismatches between services reading the same var.
